key_idea: A value can be the pivot iff it is larger than everything before it and smaller than everything after it: prefix maximum and suffix minimum.
sketch: Compute suffix minima, sweep left to right keeping the prefix maximum; a[i] is a pivot when prefmax<a[i]<sufmin (values are distinct). Count all of them but print only the first 100 in input order. O(n) with fast input for n=1e6; note the count m printed is the full count, not capped at 100.
